direction-type.words: Known as the father of the blues, W.C. Handy was also an important publisher of music by other Black composers,
and was instrumental in promoting female singers of the time like Bessie Smith. “St. Louis Blues” was so popular,
Handy was able to convince RCA to produce a film of the same name starring Smith.
